title: 국회의원청가및결석에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for requests for leave and absences of members of the National Assembly (hereinafter referred to as "Members") pursuant to Article 32 (3) of the National Assembly Act. <Amended on Mar. 18, 1995>
